name: array-access-expr-test-36e8f0c67c/unary-const-index-access-p.bal
reason: The case uses supported function calls, local declarations, list construction, array member access and unary bitwise complement. The expression ~1 evaluates to -2, so accessing the two-element array at that index must panic, as asserted by @panic. No subset restriction excludes this member-access behavior.
test_design_notes: @panic asserts an out-of-range array access panic; there are no @args or @output assertions.
